name: list_components
description: Browse the complete directory of every component across all libraries, each with its DIRECT URL (the registry JSON / shadcn install URL). Paginated — thousands of entries. Filter by registry and/or type, and page with offset/limit. Use this to enumerate what exists or to fetch a component's canonical source URL for attribution. Note: the directory includes premium/gated components too — some URLs 401 on install; use search_components(verified:true) when you need installable-only results.

registry.description: Optional registry id to restrict to one library
